categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Tigermed Consulting Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a Contract Research Organization (CRO) providing comprehensive clinical trial services for new drug development. Its main business segments include clinical trial technical services such as clinical operations, pharmacology, regulatory affairs, medical translation, pharmacovigilance, real-world research, and third-party audits and training. Additionally, it offers clinical trial-related and laboratory services including data management, statistical analysis, site management, patient recruitment, medical imaging, and laboratory testing, mainly through its subsidiary Frontage Holdings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital and intelligent technologies including AI, decentralized clinical trials (DCT), risk-based quality management (RBQM), and remote monitoring platforms to enhance clinical trial efficiency and quality. It has developed proprietary AI models and platforms such as the DeepSeek-R1 large language model and the MedBench evaluation system for medical language understanding and generation. The company also integrates electronic informed consent, remote patient follow-up, direct-to-patient drug delivery, and electronic payment systems to innovate clinical trial processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tigermed serves global pharmaceutical and medical device innovators, including multinational pharmaceutical companies, domestic large pharmaceutical firms, and small to medium innovative biotech enterprises. Its customers span various therapeutic areas such as oncology, respiratory, infectious diseases, endocrinology, hematology, neurology, cardiovascular, dermatology, immunology, digestive diseases, metabolic disorders, and rare diseases. The company supports clinical trials in China and internationally, including North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with subsidiaries and teams across more than 30 countries covering Asia-Pacific (China, Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, Australia), North America (USA, Canada), Europe (including multiple countries), Latin America, Africa, and the Middle East. It has established regional headquarters in Hong Kong and China’s northern region (Beijing), with significant presence in the US, Europe, and emerging markets to support global clinical trial operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tigermed operates primarily as a midstream service provider in the pharmaceutical and medical device R&D supply chain, offering outsourced clinical research and development services. It acts as a comprehensive CRO bridging pharmaceutical innovators and clinical trial sites, providing end-to-end clinical trial management, data services, and laboratory testing, thereby facilitating drug and device development from early clinical phases through post-marketing studies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on digital transformation and intelligent innovation, emphasizing AI-driven clinical trial optimization, decentralized trial solutions, and risk-based quality management. It invests in developing AI platforms for medical language processing, clinical trial design, patient recruitment, and data management. Tigermed also pursues global expansion through acquisitions and organic growth, enhancing its integrated service platform to support full lifecycle drug and device development with high-quality delivery and regulatory compliance.
categories.revenue_model: Tigermed generates revenue primarily through fee-for-service (FFS) and full-time equivalent (FTE) models. Under FFS, it charges clients based on specific contract terms or milestones for clinical trial services delivered. Under FTE, it charges fixed fees based on the number of dedicated project staff and their working hours. Revenue streams include clinical trial technical services, related clinical and laboratory services, medical translation, and consulting services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Tigermed is a leading CRO in China and ranks among the top global CROs, holding the largest market share in China’s clinical research outsourcing market. It competes with multinational CROs and domestic mid-sized and small CROs, leveraging its extensive experience, integrated service offerings, and global footprint. The company is recognized for its quality standards, comprehensive service coverage, and strong client relationships, positioning it as a preferred partner for innovative pharmaceutical and medical device companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tigermed reported total revenue of approximately RMB 6.6 billion, representing a 10.58% decline from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders at RMB 405 million, down 79.99%. Despite short-term revenue pressure due to industry cyclicality and client funding challenges, the company maintains a strong contract backlog of RMB 15.78 billion, up 12.1%. It employs over 10,000 staff globally, with continued investment in R&D and international expansion, reflecting a large-scale and steadily growing enterprise.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tigermed emphasizes high-quality, end-to-end clinical research services with a focus on innovation, digitalization, and global synchronization. Its unique value lies in its integrated service platform covering the entire drug and device development lifecycle, advanced AI and decentralized trial technologies, and a broad global network of clinical sites and experts. The company’s commitment to quality management, regulatory compliance, and customized solutions for diverse therapeutic areas differentiates it as a trusted partner accelerating clients’ R&D efficiency and market access.
